ecommerce_purchase.startup: server.js with schema.sql and seed.sql, loopback PORT, disposable ecommerce.db

expected_responses: 400: {error: "Insufficient inventory"} for insufficient stock or unknown product
400: {error: "Invalid product ID or quantity"} for invalid fields and form encoding
state_changes: Persist decremented inventory in SQLite; never oversell.
prerequisites: Disposable ecommerce.db initialized from schema.sql and seed.sql; product 1 starts with inventory 10.

assertions.purchase_catalog_regression: Existing product catalog and storefront remain available; an unchanged baseline failure is reported separately from remediation acceptance.

ecommerce_checkout.startup: server.js with schema.sql and seed.sql, loopback PORT, disposable ecommerce.db

expected_responses: 200: {message: "Order placed", itemCount: cart.length} after persisted server-priced order
4xx JSON error for invalid or unknown carts
non-200 JSON error on failed order insert
state_changes: Persist one orders row with total calculated from server prices before success; retain orders across restart; no persistence on invalid cart or write failure.
Browser retains cart on pending/failed requests and clears it only after confirmed success.
prerequisites: Disposable ecommerce.db initialized from schema.sql and seed.sql with two products priced at 11.25 and 7.50; real storefront, offline Chromium and real SQLite.

limitations: Email delivery, user association, line items, inventory changes and idempotency are outside this checkout profile.
Deployment and runtime soak remain pending Agent 4 verification.

assertions.checkout_persists_before_success: A one-product numeric-ID cart returns the existing 200 {message: Order placed, itemCount: 1} only after an orders row is persisted using server prices; no status literal is required.
assertions.checkout_server_priced_multiple_products: Two distinct products total 18.75 from database prices, ignoring submitted prices; itemCount equals cart length.
assertions.checkout_invalid_carts: Missing, empty, malformed, non-array, null-entry, string-ID, fractional-ID, negative-ID and unknown-ID carts return a 4xx client error without persisting an order.
assertions.checkout_write_failure_no_success: SQLite insert rejection never returns success or creates an order.
assertions.checkout_restart_persistence: Persisted orders survive application restart with the same database.
assertions.checkout_browser_confirmed_success: Real storefront keeps cart and suppresses success until actual checkout response; clears cart and shows success only after persistence.
assertions.checkout_browser_http_failure: Actual SQLite write failure causes HTTP error; browser retains cart and never shows success.
assertions.checkout_browser_network_failure: A failed checkout network request retains cart and never shows success.
assertions.checkout_catalog_regression: Existing product catalog and storefront remain available.
